# Chocolate Lava Cake

This molten chocolate lava cake is the
ultimate dessert. An easy to make and
decadent treat for all chocolate lovers!
CourseDessert
CuisineAmerican
Prep Time10 minutes
Cook Time10 minutes
Total Time20 minutes
Servings6 cakes
Calories 381 Kcal
AuthorJohn Kanell

INGREDIENTS:

▢
0.5 cup butter unsalted
▢
6 oz bittersweet chocolate
▢
2 eggs
▢
2 egg yolks
▢
0.25 cup sugar
▢
1 pinch salt
▢
2 tbs flour

INSTRUCTIONS:

1. Preheat the oven to 450F. Butter

and flour your ramekins.

2. Melt the butter with the chocolate

on low heat in a double boiler or in

the microwave. Whisk until

smooth.

3. In a medium bowl, beat the eggs

with the egg yolks, sugar and salt

until thickened and pale. An

electric mixer will work best.

4. Fold the chocolate mixture and

flour into the egg mixture. Pour the

batter into the ramekins and bake

at 450 for 6-8 minutes or even

more depending on how much lava

you want, it really depends on your

oven.

5. Let the cakes cool in the ramekins

for a minute, then cover each with

an inverted dessert plate. Carefully

turn each one over, let stand for 10

seconds and then unmold. Sift

powdered sugar on top and

garnish with berries if desired.

Serve immediately.

# Perfect Pie Crust Recipe

● Prep time: 1 hour, 15 minutes

INGREDIENTS

(ENOUGH FOR BOTTOM AND TOP
CRUST)

● 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, plus
extra for rolling
● 1 cup (2 sticks or 8 ounces)
unsalted butter, very-cold, cut into
1/2 inch cubes
● 1 teaspoon salt
● 1 teaspoon sugar
● 6 to 8 tablespoons ice water

Instructions

1 Mix flour, sugar, and salt

2 Add butter, half at a time

3 Slowly add ice water: Add ice water
tablespoon at a time until dough barely
comes together, should be able to hold
shape when squished together with
fingers

3 Make two dough disks: Carefully
empty the crumbly dough mixture from
the food processor on to a clean, dry, flat
surface. Gather the mixture in a mound.

Divide the dough mixture into two
even-sized mounds. Use your hands and
knead each mound just enough to form
each one into a disk. Do not over-knead!
Kneading develops gluten which will
toughen the dough, not something you
want in a pastry crust. You should just
knead enough so that the dough holds
together without cracks.

If you started with cold butter you should
be able to see small chunks of butter
speckling the dough. This is a good thing.
These small bits of butter will spread out
into layers as the crust cooks so you have
a flaky crust!

Sprinkle each disk with a little flour, wrap
each one in plastic wrap, and refrigerate
for one hour or up to 2 days.

# Apple Pie

Ingredients

● 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double
crust pie
● ½ cup unsalted butter
● 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
● 1 tsp cinnamon
● ¼ tsp ginger
● ¼ tsp nutmeg
● ¼ cup water
● ½ cup white sugar
● ½ cup packed brown sugar
● 8 Granny Smith apples - peeled,
cored and sliced

Directions
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F and
grease a pie pan then lay a layer of
crust on the bottom
2. Melt butter and add flower in a large
wide pot to form a paste
3. Add sugars, water, cinnamon,
nutmeg and ginger then heat and mix
until homogeneous then add apples
and cook until tender but not mushy.

Cover to cook with steam to speed
up cooking, if too much liquid boil
uncovered to get rid of water
4. Fill pie with apples then put crust on
top of pie in a design of your choice,
brush tip of pie with egg whites for a
nice shine
5. Bake 14 min at 425 then reduce to
350 and bake for about 35-45 min
until top crust is golden/darkened but
not burnt
6. Remove then rest for 10 min then
serve with ice cream

# Homemade Cinnamon Rolls
Prep Time30 mins
Cook Time22 mins
Rise Time1 hr 10 mins
Total Time1 hr 59 mins
Servings: 12

Ingredients
For the Dough:
● 1 cup warm milk (about 115 degrees F)
● 2 1/2 teaspoons instant dry yeast* (I like
Red Star Platinum Baking Yeast)
● 2 large eggs at room temperature
● 1/2 cup salted butter** (Melted, but make
sure it isn't super hot. Just barely melted,
or even softened, is fine.)
● 4 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (divided)
● 1 teaspoon salt
● 1/2 cup granulated sugar
For the Filling:
● 1/2 cup salted butter (almost melted)
● 1 cup packed brown sugar
● 2 tablespoons cinnamon
● 1/2 cup heavy cream (for pouring over
the risen rolls)
For the Frosting:
● 6 ounces cream cheese (softened)
● 1/3 cup salted butter (softened)
● 2 cups powdered sugar
● 1/2 tablespoon maple extract (or vanilla)
Instructions
● Pour the warm milk in the bowl of a
stand mixer and sprinkle the yeast
overtop.
● Add the eggs, butter, salt and sugar.
● Add in 4 cups (save the other 1/2 cup
and add only if you need it) of flour
and mix using the beater blade just until
the ingredients are barely combined.
Allow the mixture to rest for 5 minutes

so the flour has time to soak up the
liquids.
● Attach the dough hook.
● Beat the dough on medium speed,
adding in up to 1/2 cup more flour if
needed to form a dough. Knead for 5-7
minutes or until the dough is elastic and
smooth. **The dough should be tacky
and will still be sticking to the sides of
the bowl. That's ok! Don't be tempted to
add more flour at this point. We
generally add about 4 1/2 cups, but
start with 4 cups.
● Oil a large bowl, plate the dough inside
of it and cover lightly and place in a
warm place to rise from about 30 min,
too much rising can made rolls airy
● In a medium bowl, combine the soft
butter, brown sugar and cinnamon,
mixing until well combined. Set aside.
● Flour a work surface and rolling pin and
roll the dough to about a 24x15"
rectangle. Does Not have to be exact
● Smooth filling on the whole surface of
the rectangle dough make sure to NOT
to skip the edges
● Roll tightly hot-dog style and cut into 12
pieces then place in a pan to rise to
double the size
● Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.
● Warm the heavy cream until lukewarm
● Por cream evenly on the risen rolls
● Bake at 375 degrees for 20-22 minutes,
until the rolls are lightly golden brown
and the center rolls are cooked through.
Times will vary depending on size of
rolls and quantity
● In a large bowl, combine the softened
cream cheese and butter using a hand
mixer as well as extract. Blend well.
● Spread the frosting over the cooled
rolls.
● Store in an airtight container.

# Chocolate Chip Cookie Brownie Skillet

Prep Time10 mins
Cook Time20 mins
Total Time30 mins
Servings: 16 serves

Ingredients
Brownie Batter:
● 1/3 cup butter , melted
● 1/2 cup brown sugar
● 1/4 cup white sugar (or natural
granulated sweetener to cut down
on calories)
● 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa
powder
● 1 large egg
● 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
● 1/2 teaspoon salt
● 1/4 cup all-purpose flour (or plain
flour)
Cookie Dough:
● 1/4 cup butter , softened
● 1/4 cup light brown sugar
● 1/4 cup granulated sugar (or
natural granulated sweetener)
● 1 large egg
● 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
● 2/3 cup all-purpose flour (or plain
four)
● 1/8 teaspoon baking soda
● Pinch salt
● 1/3 cup dark/semi-sweet
chocolate chips

Instructions
● Heat the oven to 175°C | 350°F.
Lightly grease an 9-inch cast iron
skillet or round baking pan with

non-stick spray, butter or
vegetable oil
For The Brownie Batter:
● In a medium-sized bowl, whisk the
butter and sugars together well
until the sugar has dissolved. Add
the cocoa powder, whisking until
dissolved and smooth.
● Beat in the egg and vanilla until
well incorporated (about a
minute). Fold the flour and salt
through until the better is smooth
and thick. Set aside.
For The Cookie Dough:
● In a separate medium-sized bowl,
beat the butter and sugars
together until light and fluffy. Add
the egg and vanilla, beating until
smooth. Add in the flour, baking
soda and salt, folding the dry
ingredients through until a cookie
dough forms. Fold in half of the
chocolate chips; set aside.
Assemble:
● Pour the brownie batter into the
skillet (or pan) and spread out
evenly with a spatula (or the back
of a metal spoon). Scoop the cookie
dough into the brownie batter;
sprinkle with the remaining
chocolate chips; and bake for
30-35 minutes, or until the cookie
is golden and the edges are set and
pulled away from the sides of the
pan. Do not over bake or it will be
dry instead of moist and
fudge-like.
● Allow to cool in the pan for about
10 minutes and serve hot.

# Pizza Dough

Prep Time 15 minutes
Cook Time 15 minutes
Rising Time 30 minutes
Total Time 1 hour
Servings 12 servings (makes one 10-12"
pizza)

Ingredients
● 2-2 1/3 cups all-purpose flour OR bread
flour¹ divided (250-295g)
● 1 packet instant yeast² (2 1/4 teaspoon)
● 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar
● 3/4 teaspoon salt
● 1/8-1/4 teaspoon garlic powder and/or
dried basil leaves optional
● 2 Tablespoons olive oil + additional
● 3/4 cup warm water³ (175ml)
Instructions
● Combine 1 cup (125g) of flour,
instant yeast, sugar, and salt in a
large bowl. If desired, add garlic
powder and dried basil at this point
as well.
● Add olive oil and warm water and
use a wooden spoon to stir very well.
● Gradually add another 1 cup (125g)
of flour. Stirring until the dough is
forming into a cohesive, elastic ball
and is beginning to pull away from
the sides of the bowl. The dough will
still be slightly sticky but still should
be manageable with your hands.
● Drizzle a separate, large, clean bowl
generously with olive oil and use a
pastry brush to brush up the sides of
the bowl.
● Lightly dust your hands with flour
and form your pizza dough into a
round ball and transfer to your olive

oil-brushed bowl. Use your hands to
roll the pizza dough along the inside
of the bowl until it is coated in olive
oil, then cover the bowl tightly with
plastic wrap and place it in a warm
place.
● Allow dough to rise for 30 minutes
or until doubled in size. If you intend
to bake this dough into a pizza, I also
recommend preheating your oven to
425F (215C) at this point so that it
will have reached temperature once
your pizza is ready to bake.
● Once the dough has risen, use your
hands to gently deflate it and
transfer to a lightly floured surface
and knead briefly until smooth
(about 3-5 times).
● Use either your hands or a rolling pin
to work the dough into 12" circle.
● Transfer dough to a parchment
paper lined pizza pan and either
pinch the edges or fold them over to
form a crust.
● Drizzle additional olive oil (about a
Tablespoon) over the top of the
pizza and use your pastry brush to
brush the entire surface of the pizza
(including the crust) with olive oil.
● Use a fork to poke holes all over the
center of the pizza to keep the
dough from bubbling up in the oven.
● Add desired toppings (see the notes
for a link to my favorite, 5-minute
pizza sauce recipe!) and bake in a
425F (215C) preheated oven for
13-15 minutes or until toppings are
golden brown. Slice and serve.
Notes
I've found that all-purpose flour yields a
softer crust while bread flour gives a slightly
crispier exterior.

# Cheese Pizza
Makes one 10-12 inch pizza or however
large the dough is rolled

Ingredients
● Pizza dough
● Pizza Sauce, any kind
● Olive oil or butter
● Cheese, preferred mozzarella and
provolone sliced or shredded is fine
● Vegetable toppings optional
○ Onion
○ Pepper
● Hot pepper flakes
● Any herbs
○ Basil
○ Oregano
● Any protein topping (cooked first)
○ Chicken
○ Hotdogs
○ Lunch meats

Instructions

1. Preheat an oven to 425 with a large
heavy pan, pizza stone or skillet in
the oven to get hot, not necessarily
needed but makes pizza cook
faster/better
2. Roll pizza dough into a circle and
thicken or roll the edges to form a
crust if desired
a. If the dough keeps shrinking
back let it rest for 10-15 min
to relax gluten then continue
rolling out
3. Spread pizza sauce evenly onto the
dough
4. Add toppings, vegetables or meats
then cheese on top
5. Sprinkle red pepper flakes on top if
desired

6. Brush the crust with butter or olive
oil and drizzle pizza with olive oil
7. Place on the baking pan in the oven
to bake for 13-15 min until crust is
browned and crispy and cheese is
melty, bubbling and browned as well
is desired
8. Cool for a few minutes then cut and
serve hot

# Chocolate Chip Cookies
Makes 16 large cookies

Ingredients

● 2 and 1/4 cups (280g) all-purpose
flour (spoon & leveled)
● 1 teaspoon baking soda
● 1 and 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch*
● 1/2 teaspoon salt
● 3/4 cup (1.5 sticks or 170g) unsalted
butter, melted & slightly cooled*
● 3/4 cup (150g) packed light or dark
brown sugar
● 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar
● 1 large egg + 1 egg yolk, at room
temperature
● 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
● 1 and 1/4 cups (225g) semi-sweet
chocolate chips or chocolate chunks
Instructions
1. Whisk the flour, baking soda,
cornstarch, and salt together in a large
bowl. Set aside.

2. In a medium bowl, whisk the melted
butter, brown sugar, and granulated
sugar together until no brown sugar
lumps remain. Whisk in the egg, then
the egg yolk. Finally, whisk in the
vanilla extract. Pour the wet
ingredients into the dry ingredients
and mix together with a large spoon
or rubber spatula. The dough will be
very soft, yet thick.

3. Fold in the chocolate chunks. They
may not stick to the dough because of
the melted butter, but do your best to
combine them. Cover the dough and
chill in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours
or up to 3-4 days.

4. Chilling is mandatory. I highly
recommend chilling the cookie dough
overnight for less spreading.

5. Take the dough out of the refrigerator
and allow it to slightly soften at room
temperature for 10 minutes.

6. Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C). Line
two large baking sheets with
parchment paper or silicone baking
mats. (Always recommended for
cookies.) Set aside.

7. Roll the dough into balls, about 3
Tablespoons of dough each. The
dough will be crumbly, but the
warmth of your hands will help the
balls stay together. Roll the cookie
dough balls to be taller rather than
wide, to ensure the cookies will bake
up to be thick.

8. Place 8 balls of dough onto each
cookie sheet. Press a few more
chocolate chips/chunks on top of the
dough balls for looks, if desired.

9. Bake the cookies for 12-13 minutes.
The cookies will look very soft and
underbaked. They will continue to
bake on the cookie sheet

10. Allow to cool on the cookie sheet for
10 minutes before transferring to a
wire rack to cool completely.

Cookies stay fresh covered at room
temperature for up to 1 week.

# Spinach Puffs

Ingredients
● 2-3 cups spinach, roughly
chopped
● 3 Tbsp dill
● 1 shallot, finely minced
● 3 large cloves garlic, crushed
● Olive oil
● Salt
● Pepper
● 2 eggs, separated
● 4 ounces full fat cream cheese
● ½ cup feta cheese
● 2-4 ounces parmesan, grated
● 2-3 slices bacon, finely chopped
● 1 packet puff pastry

Instructions

1. Start by rinsing all of your spinach
and removing all of the stems.
Next, roughly chop the spinach into
small bite-sized pieces, then finely
chop 3 Tbsp dill and finely mince 1
shallot.

2. Heat a pan with olive oil over
medium-high heat and add your
finely minced shallots. Cook for
about 2 minutes or until
translucent and then add 3 large
cloves of crushed garlic. Sauté for
about 30 seconds or until fragrant.

3. Add the spinach and a pinch of salt
and cook down before adding the 3
Tbsp of dill. Sauté before adding

some fresh pepper. Remove from
heat and set aside.

4. In a mixing bowl, combine 4
ounces full fat cream cheese with
½ cup of feta cheese and 2-4
ounces of parmesan cheese. Add
the cooked spinach mixture, 2 or 3
slices of finely chopped bacon, and
one egg yolk. Stir to combine.

5. Preheat oven to 450°F

6. Liberally flour your work surface
and place your puff pastry on top
of the flour. Using a rolling pin,
lightly roll out to take out the
creases. Cut into 3-4 inch squares
and place on a parchment lined
baking sheet.

7. Add about 2 Tbsp of the mixture to
each square of puff pastry. Beat
one egg in a separate bowl and use
that to brush two edges of the puff
pastry. Crimp the egg washed
sides together. Do this for all of
your pastries and be sure to listen
to ‘80s power ballads while doing
it.

8. Place the entire baking sheet in the
fridge for 10 minutes. Remove
from the fridge and brush each
pastry with an egg wash. Place in
the oven for 20 minutes, rotating
the baking sheet at 10 minutes.

9. Remove from the oven. Let cool on
a wire rack. Serve and enjoy!

# Spaghetti and Chicken Meatballs
Servings-4 or more
Time
● Meatballs-40min to 1 hour
● Sauce-2 hours
● Pasta-10 min or more
Ingredients
● 1lb ground chicken
● ½-1 tsp garlic
● ½ tsp dry marjoram
● ½ tsp dry thyme
● ½ tsp dry basil
● ½ tsp dry oregano
● ⅓ cup bread crumbs or panko
○ half regular and half italian
flavored
● 1 egg beaten
● 1 tsp salt
● 3/4 tsp ground black pepper
● ¼ grated parmesan cheese
● Olive oil
Instructions
1. Combine ground chicken with all the
rest of the ingredients, not oil, and
mix thoroughly with hands until well
combined
2. With wet hands, for the chicken
mixture into preferred size of ball
and place on a nonstick surface
such as parchment paper
3. Heat a large wide pan with olive oil
over medium heat
4. Place the balls in the pan and cook
until bottom is brown/golden then
rotate and flip until most to all side
are brown/golden
5. Place meatballs on a plate lined with
paper to drain any oil and eat
immediately
Ingredients
● 5lb frozen/ fresh tomatoes
● 3 tbsp olive oil

● 2 chopped medium onions
● 4 cloves garlic minced
● 1 tsp dry basil
● 1 tsp dry oregano
● 1 tsp dry thyme
● 1 tsp dry marjoram
● 2 tsp salt
● 1 tsp ground black pepper
● 1 or more teaspoons sugar
(optional)
Instructions
● Peel and core the tomatoes saving
any juices
● In a pot, saute onions with oil until
just browned then garlic and cook for
about a minute or until fragrant
● Add tomatoes straight to the pot with
the seasonings and bring to a boil
then simmer for 1-1.5 hours
● Blend with an immersion blender
until smooth
● Taste and adjust for seasoning with
salt, pepper and sugar as well as
adding spice if preferred
Ingredients
● Spaghetti type pasta
● Salt olive oil
Instructions
● Bring water to a boil in a pot and salt
generously
● Once boiling, add pasta and cook
until al dente or preferred doneness
● Once cooked, strain water in a
colander
● To keep pasta from sticking, return
to the pot and mix with some olive
oil, and cover until ready to eat
Final instructions
○ Parmesan cheese grated
● Take meatballs and let simmer in the
sauce for 45 min or more on low
covered
● Reheat pasta in pot them combine with
sauce and meatball on a plate and
serve topped with grated parmesan

# Belgium Waffles
Makes 6 waffles +-

Ingredients
● 2 cups flour
● 4 tsp baking powder
● ½ tsp salt
● ½ cup sugar
● 2 eggs separated
● ½ cups vegetable oil on
● 2 cups milk
● 1-2 tsp vanilla

Instructions
1. Sift, or not, the dry ingredient in a
separate large bowl them mix
2. In a separate bowl mix egg whites
until stiff peaks
3. In a separate bowl mix vanilla, milk,
egg yolks and oil
4. Combine the wet ingredients with
the dry but not the whites
5. Fold in whites until combined
6. Cook in waffle maker on medium for
2-3 min then raise heat and cook
until steam stops and checking so it
doesn't burn too much

# Sauerkraut
Serves 4-6

Ingredients
● 4 quarts or more water
● 2 bay leaves
● ½ tsp peppercorns
● 2 tbsp butter
● 1 tbsp oil
● 2 onions
● 4 clove garlic
● 30 grams chopped fresh or dry
mushrooms
● 1 tsp coarsely ground caraway
seeds
● 1 tbsp paprika
● 2 lb sauerkraut -separated juices
and cabbage
● .5-1 lb sausage
Instructions
1. Rinse the cabbage slightly once
or twice then squeeze
2. Melt butter and oil in a large pot
until golden then add garlic
chopped until just fragrant-1 min
3. Add the sausage cut up into
medium sizes and saute until
lightly browned and juices have
started to escape from it
4. Add the caraway, paprika, bay
leaves and peppercorns
5. Immediately after add the
sauerkraut
6. Add the water in the pot, if you
want less water add less and vice
versa
7. Add the sauerkraut juices a little
bit at a time until just below your
sourness needs
8. Add the mushrooms chopped

9. Simmer for about 45 min or until
cabbage has softened then taste
for sourness and salt then add as
desired and serve hot

# Crème brûlée

Ingredients→ per 1 serving
● 1 egg yolk
● 1 tbsp sugar
● ½ tsp vanilla
● Enough heavy cream to make
quantity ½ cup
● Additional sugar and honey
for topping

Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 250F
2. Mix egg yolks and sugar until
well combined with a fork
3. Add vanilla them cream then
mix to combine making sure
to not make it frothy
4. Pour into a ramekin of about
5oz
5. Bake for about 45 min or until
consistency of jello wheel
slightly tapped
6. Cool completely in fridge
7. In a small pot, add about 1-2
tbsp sugar per serving with a
drop of honey and water and
let it cook until bubbly and
desired brownness is reached
8. Pour on top of custard them
move the ramekin around to
equally disperse the sugar
topping
9. Let cool then serve at room
temperature or cold if desired
